name: [Base] Employees in the same group
test:
alice, bob, carol, dan, eve, fran = [Node(name) for name in ('Alice', 'Bob', 'Carol', 'Dan', 'Eve', 'Fran')]
search = Node('Search', [alice, bob])
infra = Node('Infra', [fran])
platform = Node('Platform', [carol, infra])
engineering = Node('Engineering', [search, platform, eve])
sales = Node('Sales', [dan])
company = Node('Company', [engineering, sales])
assert closest_common_group(company, [alice, bob]) is search

name: [Base] Siblings and unequal depths
test:
alice, bob, carol, dan, eve, fran = [Node(name) for name in ('Alice', 'Bob', 'Carol', 'Dan', 'Eve', 'Fran')]
search = Node('Search', [alice, bob])
infra = Node('Infra', [fran])
platform = Node('Platform', [carol, infra])
engineering = Node('Engineering', [search, platform, eve])
sales = Node('Sales', [dan])
company = Node('Company', [engineering, sales])
assert closest_common_group(company, [alice, carol]) is engineering
assert closest_common_group(company, [alice, fran]) is engineering

name: [Multiple employees] A later employee changes the answer
test:
alice, bob, carol, dan, eve, fran = [Node(name) for name in ('Alice', 'Bob', 'Carol', 'Dan', 'Eve', 'Fran')]
search = Node('Search', [alice, bob])
infra = Node('Infra', [fran])
platform = Node('Platform', [carol, infra])
engineering = Node('Engineering', [search, platform, eve])
sales = Node('Sales', [dan])
company = Node('Company', [engineering, sales])
assert closest_common_group(company, [alice, bob, dan]) is company
assert closest_common_group(company, [fran, alice, carol]) is engineering

name: [Tree] Employee leaves alongside subgroup children
test:
alice, bob, carol, dan, eve, fran = [Node(name) for name in ('Alice', 'Bob', 'Carol', 'Dan', 'Eve', 'Fran')]
search = Node('Search', [alice, bob])
infra = Node('Infra', [fran])
platform = Node('Platform', [carol, infra])
engineering = Node('Engineering', [search, platform, eve])
sales = Node('Sales', [dan])
company = Node('Company', [engineering, sales])
assert closest_common_group(company, [eve, alice]) is engineering
assert closest_common_group(company, [carol, fran]) is platform

name: [Contract] Root-level employee and unchanged tree
input: root = Node('Root', [p, a]); employees = [q, p, r]
test:
p, q, r = Node('p'), Node('q'), Node('r')
b = Node('B', [q])
a = Node('A', [b, r])
root = Node('Root', [p, a])
query = [q, p, r]
nodes = [root, a, b, p, q, r]
before = [(node.name, tuple(node.children)) for node in nodes]
saved_query = list(query)
assert closest_common_group(root, query) is root
assert [(node.name, tuple(node.children)) for node in nodes] == before
assert query == saved_query
